rows.grounds: manner adverb summarizing the preceding ritual acts
absolutive indicating completion of placement before meditation
locative of locus for the placements; compound śarīra+ādi
fused form: optative verb governing the meditative object; internal sandhi at dhyāyet+śrī

items.question: Upon whom should the practitioner meditate after completing the prescribed bodily placements?
premises: The prescribed placements on the body and related locations have been completed.
The manner of these placements is summarized as thus.
The designated object of the subsequent meditation is Śrī Puruṣottama.
items.inference: After performing the described bodily placements, the practitioner should meditate on Śrī Puruṣottama.
items.plain_english: Thus, having made the placements on the body and so forth, one should meditate on Śrī Puruṣottama.
